hints.title: Fixed Window Sum Maximization
hints.text: Because the window length k is constant, maximizing the average of k elements is equivalent to maximizing their sum.

hints.title: Sliding Boundary Sum Update Invariant
hints.text: Sliding the window rightward adds the incoming element at index i and subtracts the outgoing element at index i minus k in constant time.

hints.title: Fixed Window Slide Procedure
hints.text: Compute initial sum of the first k elements. Set max sum to this initial sum. Slide the window from index k to the end of the array, adding nums[i] and subtracting nums[i - k]. Update max sum if current sum is greater. Return max sum divided by k.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing the sum of k elements at every starting position takes O(N * K) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sliding the fixed window updates the running sum in O(1) per step, taking O(N) total time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize fixed sliding window mechanics and divide by k only once at the end.
